failure_modes: Adopting C009-C011 temporal teacher blend without a validated observed-node contrast fit could apply sign-inverted coordinate targets at nodes where the continuous contrast changes sign, degrading final predicted affinity.

Adopting C005 (teacher_neighbors=2) narrows the detached teacher mixture, reducing mode coverage and increasing sensitivity to a single competing teacher direction, which can displace surrounding coordinates beyond the incumbent's max_atom_step_A/max_cumulative_rms_A budget.

Adopting C001-C003 delta curvature changes without a demonstrated affinity benefit would alter the endpoint pointcloud reward scale while leaving the underlying signed-coordinate uncertainty (q about 0.12-0.19) unresolved, so any apparent coordinate movement would not be evidence of affinity improvement.

Treating the landmark_00 softmin/occupancy3 selection contrasts as physical interaction energies or as neural-module causation would mis-specify the reward and is not supported by the supplied evidence.
rationale: Incumbent (pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, teacher_neighbors=4, static endpoint pointcloud reward, no temporal blend) is retained. H001's signed landmark_00 contrasts (softmin negative, occupancy3 positive) are only selection-node coordinate contrasts with q about 0.12-0.19 and same-sign batch fractions about 0.64-0.71, so they do not establish a reproducible direction that a registered edit would exploit; the registered choices C001-C003 change only the pointcloud delta curvature, C005-C007 change teacher count, and C004/C008-C011 change regional or temporal attention, none of which is tied by the evidence to the softmin/occupancy3 signed split. H002's continuous contrasts show 4-10 sign changes and 1-14 strong sign conflicts with no accepted polynomial and no extrapolation, so a time-conditioned teacher (C009-C011) would be applied without a validated observed-node interpolation and could inject sign-inverted coordinate targets. Because the objective is affinity-first and no current-study outcome is supplied, the defensible expected advantage of any offered edit over the incumbent is not demonstrated; retaining the incumbent avoids unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates that an unvalidated narrower neighborhood (C005) or temporal blend would risk. Temperatures remain fixed at mixture_temperature=0.5 and teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2=4.0; no temperature edit is proposed.
